name: phpmystic/liqx
description: A compiler-grounded JSX-flavored template engine for PHP. Keeps Liquid's section/schema/block model but swaps {{ }} / {% %} for real HTML + real JS-style { } expressions, with a restricted, sandboxed frontmatter subset.

scripts.lint: @php -r 'foreach (array_merge(glob("src/**/*.php"), glob("tests/**/*.php")) as $f) { exec("php -l " . escapeshellarg($f) . " 2>&1", $o, $c); if ($c) { echo implode(PHP_EOL, $o), PHP_EOL; exit(1); } } echo "lint clean", PHP_EOL;'
